description: Sequentially move supplied points outward toward the boundaries of ordered supplied discs.

provenance.relationship: Dependency extraction: ordered outward point displacement only; owner sampling/blending, neighbourhood construction and fill remain outside.

behavior.input: Exactly points,discs,strength,maxTests. Empty arrays are valid. Object records use exact-key Map and List rows traversed sequentially; values and Object numeric carriers are only Byte,Short,Integer,Long,Float,Double. All coordinates/strength are finite binary64; radius>0; strength in [0,1]; maxTests safe integer [0,9007199254740991]. No defaults.
behavior.typed: project(double[] packedXY,double[] packedDiscs,double strength,long maxTests); packedXY length even and packedDiscs length divisible by3. Validate point count/values, discs/count/values, strength, then budget. Both typed arrays must be non-null; size() is point count and points() returns detached packedXY.
behavior.preflight: Validate points then discs then strength then maxTests. Declared signed64 work N*M counts every disc including strength-zero. INVALID_INPUT precedes WORK_LIMIT; work-limit failure precedes output allocation/geometric traversal. Conversion buffers may be allocated before preflight. Object validates exact top-level keys before fields. Array maxima imply N<=1073741823 and M<=715827882; their product fits signed64. No new work-overflow error exists.
behavior.algorithm: At strength==0, after full validation and work preflight, copy points with positive-zero normalization without disc arithmetic. For each point in input order, visit discs in supplied order and update current coordinates. dx=x-cx and dy=y-cy; if either is infinite, skip that disc. hi=max(abs(dx),abs(dy)), lo=min(...); d=0 if hi=0 else hi*sqrt(1+(lo/hi)*(lo/hi)). Infinite d is outside. If d>=radius skip. Otherwise direction=(dx/d,dy/d), except d=0 uses (1,0); gap=radius-d; movement=strength*gap; newX=x+(ux*movement), newY=y+(uy*movement), each ordered binary64 operation. Nonfinite new coordinate fails NUMERIC_OVERFLOW atomically.
behavior.numeric: Separate IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest ties-even; correctly rounded sqrt; no FMA, reassociation, epsilon, trigonometry, RNG/time/host/renderer state. Normalize completed output zeros to positive zero. Axis vectors compare exactly; nonaxis vector coordinates use abs 1e-12 plus relative 1e-12 fixture tolerance.
behavior.ownership: Immutable owned result; result size equals N and preserves order. points() and toValues() detach. Inputs are stable for call and never retained; failure publishes no result.
behavior.access: size(); pointInto(long index,double[] target,int offset). Validate index in [0,MAX_SAFE] first (INVALID_INDEX), then index<size (INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE), then non-null target and overflow-safe offset>=0 and offset+2<=length (INVALID_OUTPUT), with no partial target write.
behavior.limits: O(N*M+N+M) work and primitive-array storage; no typed-loop per-point objects. This is one-pass deformation, not containment, collision resolution, clipping, Voronoi or a non-overlap guarantee.
behavior.native_forms: org.procedurals.geometry.DiscProjection2D.project(Object) and project(double[] packedXY,double[] packedDiscs,double strength,long maxTests); result size(),points(),toValues(),pointInto(long index,double[] target,int offset). No Object index overload.

errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: A completed projected coordinate is nonfinite.
errors.INVALID_INDEX: pointInto index is not a permitted long index.
errors.INVALID_OUTPUT: target/offset cannot receive two values atomically.

points.evidence: Explicit caller geometry or resource budget; independently specified reusable dependency. No artistic default or encouraged range.

discs.evidence: Explicit caller geometry or resource budget; independently specified reusable dependency. No artistic default or encouraged range.

strength.evidence: Private 0/0.45/1 study distinguishes identity, fractional and full behaviour; no recommended range.

maxTests.evidence: Explicit caller geometry or resource budget; independently specified reusable dependency. No artistic default or encouraged range.

reproduction.scope: ProjectionMarks contour and line transfer planned; no complete original recreation.

comparison: Exact JSON vectors cover axis, exactly representable3-4-5, subnormal and unchanged extreme coordinates. Native nonaxis comparisons may use per-coordinate abs1e-12+rel1e-12. Sizes, order, errors and positive-zero bits exact.
